scripts.gen:snapshot: yarn mosaic build --out snapshots --name latest --config mosaic.config.mjs
scripts.build:static:file: node scripts/static-export-route-stubs.mjs apply && (yarn cross-env MOSAIC_MODE=snapshot-file MOSAIC_OUTPUT=export next build; status=$?; node scripts/static-export-route-stubs.mjs revert; exit $status)
scripts.build:static:s3: node scripts/static-export-route-stubs.mjs apply && (yarn cross-env MOSAIC_MODE=snapshot-s3 MOSAIC_OUTPUT=export next build; status=$?; node scripts/static-export-route-stubs.mjs revert; exit $status)
scripts.serve:snapshot:file: yarn cross-env MOSAIC_MODE="snapshot-file" concurrently --kill-others -n next -p "[{name}]" "yarn dev"
scripts.serve:snapshot:s3: yarn cross-env MOSAIC_MODE="snapshot-s3" concurrently --kill-others -n next -p "[{name}]" "yarn dev"
scripts.serve: yarn cross-env MOSAIC_REVALIDATE_URL=http://localhost:3000/api/revalidate MOSAIC_REVALIDATE_SECRET=local-dev-not-a-secret concurrently --kill-others -n next,mosaic -p "[{name}]" "yarn dev" "yarn mosaic serve -c ./mosaic.config.mjs"
